metadata.title: Bang Bang Shrimp
metadata.description:
BoneFish Grill's Bang Bang Shrimp recipe, it's good!

Ingredients:
1 pound of shrimp or raw prawns
1/2 cup mayonnaise
3 Tablespoons Sweet Chili Sauce
1 Tablespoon Hot Sauce or Siracha
1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice
1/2 teaspoon Worcestershire Sauce or Fish Sauce
1/2 cup cornstarch
2 green onion tops sliced

This is wonderful and delicious.
Thank you for watching!

This video features a culinary scene, starting with the preparation of a sauce then cooking shrimp.
The video starts by showing the ingredients used. These include a yellow paste, fish sauce, and lemon. The sauce is stirred and ingredients are added. The shrimp is removed from the paste and coated with the white flour before frying. The frying results in golden shrimp.

summary.brief: The video shows how to make Bang Bang shrimp, from sauce preparation to frying and final plating.
summary.detailed: The clip begins with a close‑up of a finished shrimp dish on a black plate. A woman wearing a red shirt then prepares the sauce in a metal bowl, adding mayonnaise, sweet chili sauce, a Mexican hot sauce, a splash of lemon juice, and Worcestershire sauce, and stirring until smooth. She places peeled raw shrimp in a separate bowl, coats them with cornstarch, and drops the coated shrimp into vegetable oil heated to about 375 °F, deep‑frying them for roughly two to three minutes until golden. Using tongs she lifts the shrimp, drains them on a strainer, and immediately tosses the hot shrimp in the prepared sauce. She plates the coated shrimp on a black dish beside a mound of white rice, garnishes the shrimp with chopped green‑onion tops, adds a sprinkle of parsley, places a sprig of cilantro under the rice, and sets a lemon wedge on the side. The final segment holds a close‑up of the plated dish on a wooden table, slowly zooms out, and ends with a music‑credit graphic.

1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice
1/2 teaspoon Worcestershire Sauce or Fish Sauce
1/2 cup cornstarch
2 green onion tops sliced
